packageRules.description: Dependabot's cargo group: one pull request for the minor and patch updates of the workspace's crates from 1.0 up. The shared preset does not enable cargo, so it is enabled above; weekly, like Dependabot. A regex matchCurrentVersion is read against the version in Cargo.lock (the manifest's range when there is none), which shares the range's major: "0.5" locks a 0.5.x, so a 0.x crate is left to the two rules below, while "1" and "9" are not 0.x.
A 0.x crate's patch updates are compatible under Cargo semver, so they stay in the group.
A 0.x minor (0.5 -> 0.6) is breaking under Cargo semver: one pull request per crate, so one migration does not hold back the rest.
Dependabot proposed workflow action updates weekly, all in one pull request, for the performance workflow that stays on GitHub.
